goals: Verify the CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) functionalities of the Books API.
Ensure the Books API correctly handles requests for existing and non-existing book resources.
activities: Define a new book object with title, author, genre, and copies available.
Send a POST request to the /api/books endpoint with the new book data.
Assert the response status code is 201.
Assert the response body's title is 'Dune'.
